The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of the work:

## What was broken and what I built

The supplied package had type visitors, an expression AST, a graph skeleton and stubs (`wire.decode`, `state.prepare`, `offline.execute` all raised `NotImplementedError`). I implemented the whole offline pipeline inside the supplied package:

**`ast.py`** — type algebra (`Int/String/Enum/Array/Struct/Alias/Void`) with transparent alias resolution, a lazy forward-reference-safe `TypeEnv`, module records, constant folding that never truncates string constants (including inside aggregates), deep type-identity-preserving equality, and a hashable corpus identity.

**`expr.py`** (new) — the typed predicate language compiled once per module into closures: `var/const/field/index/all/match/not` plus binary operators with exact modulo-2^bits arithmetic and left-to-right short circuiting. `all` bindings shadow lexically and never leak to enclosing or sibling predicates.

**`regex.py`** — a real parser and Thompson NFA for the documented pattern grammar (unions, sequences, `*`, groups, classes, escapes, empty/nullable patterns, Latin-1 matching) replacing the broken `str(regex)`-through-`re` approach.

**`oracles.py`** — the `MainBuilder` numbering convention: inputs then result, composites reserve an ID but contribute no object, `String(N)` yields a buffer ID plus N character objects, aliases reserve nothing and add no path component; plus the dependency-before-user declaration post-order and strict leaf recovery (bool 0/1, int padding bits, enum range, NUL truncation).

**`composer.py`** — call/pipe dependency edges, transitive prerequisites, Kahn ordering with the lexicographically smallest eligible module; fixed duplicate-edge miscounting that broke reused filters.

**`wire.py`** — strict KTEST v3: base64 validation, blob framing, argument limits, canonical `x<digits>` names, no trailing bytes, exact inventory/width checks.

**`state.py`** — guards evaluated on the recovered entry inputs (including the desired state), distinct-guard grouping, exact minimum preparation by `(cost, command count, lexicographic commands)` via reverse Dijkstra plus greedy reconstruction.

**`offline.py` / `campaign_cli.py`** — the joined pipeline: plans, per-run records (`INVALID_TEST` → `FILTERED` → `UNREACHABLE` → `READY`/`DUPLICATE` precedence), flag attestation against transitive pipe acceptance, and corpus assembly keyed on recovered inputs rather than model returns.

Validated with the public fixtures (via a local mirror, since this sandbox denies `kill`/`setpgid`), a project self-test suite, eight domain suites, a randomized fuzzer, and a 56 MB maximum-scale campaign that completes in ~10 s against the 120 s budget.
